page.layout: One printed title page, centred, with a publisher's imprint at the foot. The scan is heavily overlaid by show-through from the reverse, so most lines are uncertain.
page.notes: The title page is set in roman capitals and italics, but the scan shows mirrored show-through from the other side, which I have not transcribed. The top line and the large central word are clear enough to read only in part. The lower lines are mostly illegible. The date at the foot appears to read 1605, but this is doubtful. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is visible.
